_about: Hand-curated overlay (ARCHITECTURE §2.4): only facts GTFS cannot express. Station references are GTFS parent stop ids; every reference is resolved by scripts/build_nyc_network.py, which fails on anything that does not resolve. Keys starting with '_' and 'note' fields are documentation.

turnbacks.note: 57 St-7 Av: relay/layup tracks north of the station (former N/Q/W terminal).
Chambers St (Nassau St): 4-track station with relay capacity; J/Z short-turn location.
2 Av: express tracks east of the station used as relay (former V terminal).
Bowling Green: stub/loop tracks used by terminating Lexington Av trains.
111 St: center track used to relay Jamaica line trains.
Bedford Av: crossovers at the Brooklyn end of the Canarsie Tube; the tube-closure plan ran Brooklyn-only L service relaying here.
